terms-and-conditions.title: This app is part of a research project
terms-and-conditions.description: WeCreateX is part of MA research at King's College London to explore the future of creativity.
terms-and-conditions.check-boxes-title: Tick every box to accept the terms and conditions and proceed.

terms.1: I confirm that I have read and understood the information sheet (V2) dated 17/06/2024 for the above project. I have had the opportunity to consider the information and asked questions which have been answered to my satisfaction.
terms.2: I consent voluntarily to be a participant in this project and understand that I can refuse to take part and can withdraw from the project at any time, without having to give a reason, up until the 17th of August 2024
terms.3: I consent to the processing of my personal information for the purposes explained to me in the Information Sheet. I understand that such information will be handled in accordance with the terms of the General Data Protec5on Regulation (GDPR) and the UK Data Protection Act 2018.
terms.4: I understand that my information may be subject to review by responsible individuals from the College for monitoring and audit purposes.
terms.5: I understand that confidentiality and anonymity will be maintained, and it will not be possible to identify me in any research outputs.
terms.6: I understand that I must not take part if I fall under the exclusion criteria as detailed in the information sheet and explained to me by the researcher.
terms.7: I  understand that the information I have submited will be published as a report.
terms.8: I understand that I might be approached for an interview.
terms.9: I have read the Information Sheet, the Terms and Conditions and the Consent Form and I accept the terms and conditions and consent to take part in the research

survey.title: Please rate 10 research statements (max 1 min) and collect your credits after.

opinions.1: I enjoy filmmaking and/or acting very much.
opinions.2: Filmmaking and/or acting is fun to do.
opinions.3: I would describe filmmaking and/or acting as very interesting.
opinions.4: While I am making films and/or acting, I am thinking about how much I enjoy it.
opinions.5: I think I am quite good at filmmaking and/or acting.
opinions.6: I am satisfied with my creative performance.
opinions.7: I believe filmmaking and/or acting is valuable to me.
opinions.8: I think filmmaking and/or acting are important.
opinions.9: I put a lot of effort into filmmaking and/or acting.
opinions.10: It is important to me to do well in filmmaking and/or acting.
